newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D shares gain on South China Post deal.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D shares gain on South China Post deal.

text.p: Shares in M.A.I.D Plc MAID.O rose on Monday after the online information group confirmed it had reached agreement with the South China Morning Post to design and implement an Internet business service.
The stock was up 6-1/2p at 185 by 0852 GMT in thin volume of 26,807 shares. "It's obviously reasonably bullish news," said one market-maker in the stock.
The Internet site, to be launched in the second quarter of 1997, will add M.A.I.D's business information to the paper's existing news site on the Internet.

M.A.I.D said the agreement forms part of its strategy of broadening its distribution base worldwide. The service will provide a personal portfolio allowing subscribers to track a selection of public companies, will give an alert service and will also allow access to newswires and a news archive.
